cases.translation: The flag proudly waved over the square.
cases.explain: Флаг is the subject of реял (waved), so nominative.

cases.translation: The squads marched onto the square.
cases.explain: The preposition на (onto) with motion takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: Yurka headed to the hiding spot by the unfinished building.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

cases.translation: He could only think about the parting.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Yurka put his hand on Olezhka's shoulder.
cases.explain: The possessive-style dative here marks Olezhka as the person whose shoulder is touched (plечо + dative of the person).

cases.translation: They hid behind the bush by the cliff.
cases.explain: The preposition за (behind) with a static location takes the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ира Петровна догоняла их со своим ___.
cases.translation: Ira Petrovna was catching up to them with her flashlight.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: He could not tear himself away from Volodya.
cases.explain: The preposition от (away from) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Гордый, причёсанный и опрятный, в белых перчатках Юрка жаждал поскорее увидеться с Володей.
reading.question: How did Yurka feel carrying the squad's banner at the closing ceremony?
options: Proud and eager to see Volodya soon
reading.correct: Proud and eager to see Volodya soon
reading.explain: The text says the proud, neatly groomed Yurka, wearing white gloves, longed to see Volodya as soon as possible.

reading.ru: Красная ласточка на фоне лазурного полотна, а над головой в чистом небе белые зонтики парашютов опускались по синеве вниз.
reading.question: What did the camp flag look like, flying over the ceremony?
options: A red swallow against an azure background
A hammer and sickle on red
reading.correct: A red swallow against an azure background
reading.explain: The text describes the camp flag as a red swallow (lastochka) against an azure background.

reading.ru: Юрка смотрел на спуск флага и пел со всеми «Взвейтесь кострами, синие ночи».
reading.question: What song did Yurka sing along with everyone as the flag was lowered?
options: The pioneer anthem "Vzveytes kострами, sinie nochi"
reading.correct: The pioneer anthem "Vzveytes kострами, sinie nochi"
reading.explain: Yurka watches the flag descend while singing the pioneer anthem "Vzveytes kострами, sinie nochi" with everyone.

reading.ru: Детство кончилось недавно, этим летом, в ласточке, когда он встретил Володю.
reading.question: When did Yurka feel his childhood truly ended?
options: This summer at Lastochka, when he met Volodya
When he took off his scarf for good
When his piano teacher failed him
reading.correct: This summer at Lastochka, when he met Volodya
reading.explain: The text states his childhood ended recently, this summer at Lastochka, when he met Volodya.

reading.ru: Юрка думал об этой В и об этом В.
reading.question: What was Yurka thinking about as he walked down the avenue of pioneer-heroes?
options: The chalk letter V drawn inside an apple shape
reading.correct: The chalk letter V drawn inside an apple shape
reading.explain: Walking down the avenue, Yurka's mind is on the untouched, beloved letter V in the apple shape he sees from afar.

reading.ru: Я тут вспомнил, как после последнего звонка наш класс заложил под деревом в школьном дворе послание для будущих выпускников.
reading.question: What memory from his own school does Yurka bring up to Volodya?
options: Burying a time capsule with a message for future graduates
Planting a tree with his classmates
Hiding a diary in his desk
reading.correct: Burying a time capsule with a message for future graduates
reading.explain: Yurka recalls how, after his class's last school bell, they buried a message for future graduates under a tree.

reading.ru: «Я могу положить туда ноты колыбельные.
reading.question: What does Yurka decide to put in their own time capsule?
options: The sheet music for the lullaby
reading.correct: The sheet music for the lullaby
reading.explain: Yurka excitedly suggests putting the sheet music of the lullaby into the capsule.

reading.ru: Ночью был дождь, река, наверное, разлилась.
reading.question: What does Volodya tell Yurka to check about the river near the willow?
options: Whether the rain has made it swell
Whether the boat is still there
reading.correct: Whether the rain has made it swell
reading.explain: Volodya asks Yurka to check the ford, since it rained overnight and the river's probably risen.

reading.ru: «Спасибо за лучшую смену в «Ласточке».
reading.question: What did Yurka write on the girls' pioneer scarves?
options: "Thanks for the best session at Lastochka"
reading.correct: "Thanks for the best session at Lastochka"
reading.explain: Yurka writes on each scarf, without much thought, "Thanks for the best session at Lastochka, Konev, second session, 1986."

reading.ru: «Кстати, Йор, ты мне один адрес обещал!» Подмигнув, протянула Ксюша.
reading.question: What did Ksyusha remind Yurka he had promised her?
options: An address (of a boy she liked)
reading.correct: An address (of a boy she liked)
reading.explain: Ksyusha winks and reminds Yurka that he promised her someone's address.

reading.ru: «Юла, я видел, как Пчёлкин стылил с кухни спички!» Запыхавшийся Олежка выглядел очень обеспокоенным.
reading.question: What worried Olezhka enough to run to Yurka's group?
options: He saw Pchyolkin steal matches from the kitchen
reading.correct: He saw Pchyolkin steal matches from the kitchen
reading.explain: Out of breath, Olezhka reports that he saw Pchyolkin steal matches from the kitchen.

reading.ru: Я верю, что из тебя получится отличный пионер, а потом лучший комсомолец.
reading.question: What does Yurka tell Olezhka he believes about his future?
options: That he'll become a great pioneer and later a good Komsomol member
That he'll become camp director someday
That he should quit trying to speak clearly
That he'll never make it as a pioneer
reading.correct: That he'll become a great pioneer and later a good Komsomol member
reading.explain: Yurka tells Olezhka he believes he'll turn out to be an excellent pioneer, and later, a good Komsomol member.

reading.ru: Казалось, что это случилось целую вечность назад, но до чего же отчетливо помнился тот поцелуй.
reading.question: What boat did Yurka seek out at the boathouse before heading to the willow?
options: The one where he and Volodya hid from the rain under a tarp
The boat used for the play's props
reading.correct: The one where he and Volodya hid from the rain under a tarp
reading.explain: Yurka is drawn to the very boat where he and Volodya once hid from the rain together.

reading.ru: «Держи!» Володя протянул ему два пирожка с маком.
reading.question: What snack did Volodya hand Yurka when they met outside the dining hall?
reading.correct: Two poppy-seed buns
reading.explain: Volodya greets Yurka with "Here!" and hands him two poppy-seed buns.

reading.ru: Наступил вечер, и он действительно был синим, а костер без преувеличения взмывал в чернильное небо, разбрасывая искры так высоко, что они мешались со звездами.
reading.question: What did the campfire look like against the night sky?
options: Its sparks flew so high they mixed in with the stars
It was small and quickly went out
It was hidden behind the trees
reading.correct: Its sparks flew so high they mixed in with the stars
reading.explain: The text says the bonfire soared into the ink-dark sky, scattering sparks so high they mingled with the stars.

reading.ru: Усмехнулся, ласково посмотрел на Ульяну.
reading.question: What did Mitka do before playing the song that upset the camp?
options: He chuckled and looked fondly at Ulyana before announcing the dedication
He tuned his guitar for several minutes
He asked Ira Petrovna for permission
He handed the guitar to someone else
reading.correct: He chuckled and looked fondly at Ulyana before announcing the dedication
reading.explain: Mitka chuckles, looks affectionately at Ulyana, then dedicates the song to everyone who fell in love that summer.

reading.ru: «Я тебя никогда не забуду».
reading.question: What line from the song did Volodya silently mouth to himself?
reading.correct: "I will never forget you"
reading.explain: Yurka reads on Volodya's lips the words "Ya tebya nikogda ne zabudu" — I will never forget you.

reading.ru: «Я тебя никогда не забуду», – прошептал Володя.
reading.question: How did Yurka perceive Volodya whispering the song's line?
options: He somehow heard it clearly in his heart, in Volodya's own voice
He couldn't tell what Volodya said at all
He thought Volodya was singing along cheerfully
He assumed Volodya wasn't paying attention
reading.correct: He somehow heard it clearly in his heart, in Volodya's own voice
reading.explain: Though he couldn't truly have heard it, Yurka says the words rang out clearly, in Volodya's own voice, straight in his heart.

reading.ru: Сделаем крюк, пройдём через лес, чтобы за нами никто не увязался».
reading.question: What plan did Volodya whisper to Yurka to avoid being followed?
options: Take a roundabout route through the woods so no one tags along
Wait until midnight to leave separately
Ask Ira Petrovna to distract Masha
reading.correct: Take a roundabout route through the woods so no one tags along
reading.explain: Volodya whispers that they'll take a detour through the woods so nobody follows them.

reading.ru: Лопатка, капсулы и вещи, которые туда положим.
reading.question: What did Volodya say was inside his backpack?
options: A small shovel, the capsule, and items to put in it
reading.correct: A small shovel, the capsule, and items to put in it
reading.explain: Volodya says the backpack holds a small shovel, the capsule, and the things they'll put inside it.

reading.ru: «Вы куда?» Володя не растерялся, молча стащил с плеч рюкзак, вынул капсулу, замотанную в целлофан, железную коробку с крышкой.
reading.question: What did Volodya pull from his backpack when Ira Petrovna caught up to them?
options: A metal box wrapped in cellophane — the time capsule
reading.correct: A metal box wrapped in cellophane — the time capsule
reading.explain: Caught by Ira, Volodya calmly pulls out the cellophane-wrapped metal box — the time capsule — to explain themselves.

reading.ru: «Не отпускайте их!
reading.question: What did Masha scream out to stop Ira from letting them go?
options: That they were abnormal and kissing and hugging each other
That they planned to run away from camp
reading.correct: That they were abnormal and kissing and hugging each other
reading.explain: Masha screams that they are abnormal, that they kiss and hug, and that Olga Leonidovna must be told.

reading.ru: «Я и сама поначалу не верила.
reading.question: How did Ksyusha initially react to Masha's accusation?
options: She didn't believe it at first, and thought Masha liked Konev instead
She immediately reported it to Olga Leonidovna
She refused to discuss it at all
reading.correct: She didn't believe it at first, and thought Masha liked Konev instead
reading.explain: Ksyusha says she didn't believe it herself at first, and had assumed Masha had a crush on Konev instead.

reading.ru: На первый раз прощаю, но если ты продолжишь свои россказни, я сразу отведу тебя к Ольге Леонидовне и расскажу ей все про твои ненормальные фантазии».
reading.question: What warning does Ira Petrovna give Masha after the confrontation?
options: That she'll be reported to Olga Leonidovna if she keeps telling these stories
That she'll be sent home immediately
That she'll lose her role in future plays
reading.correct: That she'll be reported to Olga Leonidovna if she keeps telling these stories
reading.explain: Ira warns Masha she's forgiven this once, but will be taken straight to Olga Leonidovna if she keeps up these tales.

reading.ru: Ира Петровна утонул в лесной тишине.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: With Ira Petrovna's voice fading into the silence of the forest
With Volodya and Yurka finally kissing
reading.correct: With Ira Petrovna's voice fading into the silence of the forest
reading.explain: The final line says Ira Petrovna's voice dissolved into the quiet of the forest.
